meta.description: Join the Telemavix GPS closed alpha for Android. Record GPS tracks and phone telemetry, then save your activities as FIT and GPX files.

heading: Closed alpha testing
pageHeading: Telemavix GPS for Android - closed alpha testing
intro: Try Telemavix GPS on Android. Record your route and phone sensor readings, then use them to add a map and speed to your video in [Telemavix Studio](/projects/telemavix). With a DJI Osmo Action 4, 5 Pro or 6, your phone can also act as a Bluetooth GPS remote.

items.title: Camera control
items.text: Connect your phone to a DJI Osmo Action 4, 5 Pro or 6 over Bluetooth. With linked recording enabled, starting or stopping a route in the app controls video recording. If you start recording with the camera button, the app records the route until the video stops. It also warns you about low camera battery, low card space and overheating.

items.title: GPS positions in the MP4 file
items.text: Your phone sends GPS positions and time to the camera. The camera embeds them directly in the MP4 file, and Studio reads them from the footage. Use a separate FIT or GPX track to add phone sensor readings or fill gaps in the GPS data.

items.title: Route recording
items.text: The app tracks distance, moving time, elevation gain and grade. It supports auto-pause and records with the screen off. If recording is interrupted, reopen the app to recover the data it saved.

items.title: Phone telemetry
items.text: Readings from available phone sensors, including the barometer, accelerometer, gyroscope and light sensor, are saved alongside your route and battery data. Choose which sensor data to record in settings.

items.title: Dashboard and offline map
items.text: Follow your speed and other live readings on the dashboard, and your route on an OpenStreetMap map. Previously loaded areas of the map remain available offline.

items.title: Satellites and sun
items.text: Check satellite positions on a sky chart and monitor GPS signal quality. Sunset reminders help you plan your return before dark.

items.title: History and export
items.text: Review a route preview, activity summary and speed and elevation charts in your history. Share the FIT or GPX file to open it on your computer in [Telemavix Studio](/projects/telemavix).

items.title: Extras
items.text: Customize the app with distance alerts, a touch lock above your chosen speed or a music player widget. Choose a theme and use metric or imperial units.

how.title: How to join the closed alpha
steps: Enter the email address of the Google account you use in the Play Store.
Your address will be added to the tester list on Google Play. This usually takes up to a week, sometimes less.
You'll receive an email with a link to join the test and install the app.
Use the app during your activities. Let me know about bugs and share your ideas for improvements.
how.note: Testing lasts 14 days. This is an early alpha, so you may encounter bugs and features may change. Testing is currently available on Android only.

form.title: Sign up
form.consent: I agree to the processing of my email address to add me to the closed test and to contact me about it. The address will be deleted once testing ends, and I can ask for its removal at any time. More in the [privacy policy]({{privacyUrl}}).
form.success: Thank you for signing up! Your address has been saved. You'll receive an email once you've been added to the tester list. This usually takes up to a week, sometimes less.
